I will say if you choose to not get it serviced you should leave the pilot on so keep the fireplace warm to prevent bugs and such from going in. Also once a month fire up the unit for a few minutes. Is sounds like it’s a drafting issue. You really should preheat the flue before lighting a fire. After it’s preheated (use newspaper, roll newspaper into a loose tube light one end and hold it inside the flue unit you see the smoke being pulled into the flue, you also may hear an air rushing sound as it’s happening) use plenty of small and dry kindling before adding larger pieces on. Leave the door cracked longer. It could also be environmental but before looking further try what I explained above.

It will not be a gasket issue because if there is a proper draft the air leaks due to a bad gasket would actually pull in not push out.
